sample_unit: coronary angiography reports (100 internal test, 100 external test)
unlisted_practices: Converting free-text coronary angiography reports into a standardized hierarchical annotation schema with an LLM before extracting key information
Comparing LLM framework extraction accuracy against a direct extraction baseline using a consensus reference standard of two cardiologists

screen.reason: The study develops and validates an LLM-based pipeline (using GPT-4o) to extract and structure information from free-text coronary angiography reports across two hospital datasets, measuring extraction accuracy without evaluating a deployment guardrail.
